title: RandomItemsMinigame
description: A simpel minigame where you get random items and kills give you more random items and deaths less
body:
# RandomItems Minigame
A minigame where each player only gets random items and must try to kill others. Doing that gives you more random items in the future. But dying: you get less random items in the future.

## Usage:
Put the plugin file into your folder directory of your minecraft server. Reaload the server.
Run 
```
/begin <password>
```
 to start the minigame. The password field is the password from the plugin's config.yml. The standard password is "password" please change it lol.

## The game:
1. Each player gets teleported to the spawn (0 0)
2. Each player starts with one slot where random items can spawn
3. When a player kills another the victim "looses" one slot. E.g. it had two slots with random items, now it only has one and gets less random items! The other player now has one more slot and therefore gets more random items! You can't have 0 slots
4. Each 30s the old items get removed and the players will get new items (each slot 0-64)
5. Each 30s to one minute new teams will be made: Being in a team means, if your teammate dies you get slowness 4 for 20 seconds as a punishment.
6. The first player with 15 slots wins the game or the player with the most after 5 min.
7. The leaderboard shows the top 3 players.

## Attention:
The plugin will make a worldborder, and place a bedrock block as the spawn at 0 0. Please note that this can lead to destruction of your world (well one block)
The world must be manually reset after each game which can be easily done with other plugins.
You can change most values like time between new items in the config.yml
